  • Explore the History of Missouri's Governors
    Image
    The Hall of Governors is a monumental tribute honoring the leaders who shaped Missouri's history.
    Learn More >>
  • Your Career Growth Starts with the State of Missouri
    Image
    Join the State of Missouri's team of proud public servants for a challenging and transformative career experience.
    Apply Now >>
  • Visiting the Capitol? Get the Details.
    Image
    Find the latest information, including maps and security precautions, for accessing the Missouri State Capitol Building.
    More Information >>
  • Connect with State Procurement: MissouriBUYS
    Image
    MissouriBUYS is the procurement platform for State government, providing public bid/contract boards and supplier self-services for electronic purchases.
    Learn More >>
  • Find Your Next Career in Missouri
    Image
    Jobs.mo.gov is the top Missouri employment resource, offering daily job searches, personalized openings, and a searchable electronic job seeker summary for employers.
    Search Jobs >>

    Visit Missouri

    • Gateway Arch National Park
      Image
      Gateway Arch National Park commemorates Thomas Jefferson’s vision of a unified continental nation and St. Louis’s role as the gateway to the American West. The 91-acre park also preserves the Old Courthouse, the site of the first two trials of the pivotal Dred Scott v. Sandford case.
      Learn more >>
    • Elephant Rocks State Park
      Image
      Resembling massive circus elephants, the towering pink granite boulders at Elephant Rocks State Park create a natural playground with sweeping views of the rolling Ozark Mountains.
      Explore MO State Parks >>
    • Ha Ha Tonka State Park
      Image
      Located in the Missouri Ozarks, Ha Ha Tonka State Park’s rugged bluffs, historic castle, cool blue spring, and scenic hiking trails create a majestic natural haven ripe for exploration.
      Explore MO State Parks >>
    • North Fork River
      Image
      The North Fork River is one of Missouri’s most stunning streams, winding through the Ozark hills for about 109 miles. With spring-fed waters, fast-moving riffles, and perfect swimming holes, this river is a dream for canoeists, kayakers, and tubing enthusiasts.
      Learn more >>
    • National World War I Museum and Memorial
      Image
      Towering over downtown Kansas City, the National WWI Museum and Memorial interprets the Great War, examines its lasting impacts and honors veterans.
      Learn more >>
      Image

      Governor Mike Kehoe

      Mike Kehoe was sworn in as Missouri's 58th Governor on January 13, 2025. Guided by a lifelong dedication to public service and a commitment to Missouri families, Governor Kehoe has made public safety, education, economic development, and agriculture the cornerstones of his administration.

      Raised as the youngest of six children by a single mother who worked tirelessly to support her family, Governor Kehoe learned the value of hard work and resilience at an early age. Starting his career washing cars at 15, he advanced through the automotive industry to become one of the youngest Ford dealers in the nation. Later, he turned around Osage Industries, a struggling ambulance manufacturing company in Linn, Missouri, transforming the business into one of the largest ambulance manufacturers in the nation.

      Visit the Governor’s site »
